resources.string: YouTube requested additional verification. Kinescope updated yt-dlp and tried fallback modes. Sign in to YouTube in Settings or try again later from your home connection.
This video is age-restricted. Sign in to YouTube in Settings and try again.
Video unavailable — it may have been removed, region-blocked, or the link may be invalid.
Downloaded output file was not found.
Could not save the downloaded file.
Couldn\'t undo a completed save after the control request. Delete the file from Library and try again.
Only youtube.com and youtu.be links are supported.
No internet connection — some downloads could not start.
YouTube is asking for verification. Kinescope already tried automatic recovery; signing in can make the session more trustworthy.
Nothing queued. Use the center button below or share a YouTube link into Kinescope.
Paste a YouTube link. If a valid link is already in the clipboard, Kinescope fills it automatically when you open this screen.
No app found to play this file
No app found to share this file
New files are saved under Downloads/%1$s. Existing files are not moved when this changes.
yt-dlp powers every download. Kinescope uses the nightly channel so extractor fixes arrive faster when YouTube changes.
A YouTube web session is saved on this device.
No YouTube web session is saved.

Optional. A signed-in session can help with verification and age-restricted videos, but YouTube may still rate-limit an IP or invalidate cookies. Google may also block sign-in inside embedded browsers. Avoid high-volume automated downloading with your main account.
Sign in on the real YouTube page below, then tap “Use this session”. Cookies stay inside Kinescope’s private app storage and are passed to yt-dlp only for YouTube downloads.
Kinescope did not detect an authenticated session. Finish signing in to YouTube and try again.
Could not prepare private download storage.
Android stopped the long-running download service. Tap Resume to continue.
Could not start the download service. The job was saved; tap Resume to try again.
This video is already queued or waiting for retry.
Paste a direct YouTube video, Shorts, Live, or youtu.be link.
Waiting for the active download to finish before updating yt-dlp…
Use downloads only where you have the right to save the content. Kinescope does not bypass access controls or DRM.
The file will be removed from the device and cannot be restored by Kinescope.
Logs redact URLs, cookies, private app paths, and raw extractor output before they are stored.

Helps when a network (for example a workplace Wi-Fi) blocks YouTube by inspecting connection headers. Downloads are routed through a small engine built into Kinescope that splits and reorders the first packets of each connection. It is not a VPN: it does not hide your IP address or encrypt traffic. It cannot help when the network blocks DNS lookups or the IP addresses themselves.
A working strategy was found and selected.
No strategy got through on this network. Repeat the search on the restricted network, or update the list.
YouTube is reachable directly on this network, so there is nothing to compare. Run the search on the restricted network.
The bypass engine did not start.
The direct connection works, so the bypass is not needed here.
This network does not resolve YouTube names. Splitting packets cannot fix that; a different DNS would be needed.
This network blocks DNS lookups for YouTube and the engine cannot resolve the names either. Splitting packets does not fix that.
This network refuses connections to YouTube servers (TCP failure). Splitting packets usually does not help with that.
Connections reach the servers but are cut during the TLS handshake. The bypass can sometimes get around that, so run the strategy search.
The direct connection is blocked but the bypass gets through. Switch the bypass on.
Neither the direct connection nor the bypass works. Try another strategy or update the list.
The bypass engine is not available.
The list is already up to date (%1$d strategies).
The ByeDPI engine is built into the app and is updated together with it. Here the list of strategies is updated.
